lines.line: Eleven empires invaded this small land. Watch who stayed.
722 BCE. Assyria conquers the northern kingdom and deports its people.
586 BCE. Babylon destroys Jerusalem and its Temple, and exiles Judah.
539 BCE. Persia lets the exiles go home and rebuild.
In 70 CE, Rome burns the Second Temple.
In 135, it crushes the last revolt and renames the land.
Byzantium. The caliphate in 636. Crusaders in 1099. Mamluks in 1260.
In 1488, a visiting rabbi counts seventy Jewish families in Jerusalem.
1516, the Ottomans. Their own tax records count about seven thousand Jews.
By the 1880s, fifteen to twenty four thousand.
1917, Britain. Its own census: about 84,000 Jews in 1922. 175,000 in 1931.
Many peoples lived here too, and their history is real.
Every empire left. The Jewish people never did.
If you love Israeli facts, follow Noam Roz for more.
So count them again. Eleven empires.
